lane: perf-daemon-lazyinit2-fast (the install-id cut, approved-as-next after L1; the second inline fsync the settle leg2 decompose banked)
hypothesis: The telemetry install-id create (install_id.rs) carries a TS-absent fsync at BOTH publish sites: TS's fresh create is writeFileSync with flag 'wx' (Node never fsyncs) and its invalid-state replacement is writeFileAtomicSync WITHOUT the fsync option (the same per-call-site opt-in shape L1 ported for the supervisor-config persist) — the Rust port's create_exclusive ends with file.sync_all(), added durability the product does not have. The create sits in the daemon's PRE-BIND telemetry block (supervisor.rs run(), build_client), so its fsync rides the bind-span of every daemon-booting create path on a fresh agent dir (once per agent dir; the settle leg2 measured it 31-34ms inline on its host class). Dropping it to the TS posture should remove exactly ONE fresh-write+fsync class op from the bind-span.
approach: Branch lane/perf-daemon-installid-unsync (base 2231687fc, then folded to the moved tip cca05169d, folded head 6aa71e81d), ONE file crates/pa-telemetry/src/install_id.rs +17/-7: create_exclusive drops the trailing file.sync_all(); the TS posture documented at the module doc, the fn doc, and the no-hard-link fallback; the hard-link publish mechanism (the documented port hardening: unique temp + hard_link, losers re-read and converge on the durable id) untouched. MEASUREMENT FIXTURE FIDELITY FINDING (binding): the L1 ABBA's PI_OFFLINE=1 posture DISABLES the telemetry block entirely (pa-telemetry env.rs: PI_OFFLINE truthy -> Some(false) -> build_client never runs -> install_id never called) — so the L1 ABBA never exercised the install-id create, and this measurement requires the telemetry-ON posture. leg_abba.py gained --telemetry (PRIME_AGENT_TELEMETRY=1, no PI_OFFLINE, no DO_NOT_TRACK; the env override wins over any settings file), disclosed in every row and the head row; the default posture (PI_OFFLINE=1) is unchanged. Measurement: the prebuilt same-VM sequential ABAB pair, n=12/leg-instance, shapes prewarmed+inline, fresh agent dir per trial (the install-id create fires on every boot), sha-asserted swaps, spin calib pre/mid/post, grid floor probe, I/O advisory v1.0 regime probes at every leg boundary, idle gates, SIGTERM reap + leftover-poison check.
parity_notes: A CONVERGENCE, not a divergence: TS fsyncs NEITHER install-id site (telemetry.ts:276-283 fresh create writeFileSync flag wx; telemetry.ts:238-240 -> atomic-file.ts writeFileAtomicSync without the fsync option — verified in the TS source with citations carried in the Rust doc comments). The port's convergence hardening is kept exactly (the hard-link publish, converge-on-durable-id, 0600 privacy); the 64-round concurrent_create_stress_converges battery passes untouched. Crash class unchanged and documented: a lost create re-creates next boot (read_install_id fails); a torn or empty durable file is invalid state, replaced atomically. No protocol/wire/user-visible surface touched (a private fs helper in a telemetry state-file writer).
